author: JoHeidecke
text: 1/ Safety is core to every model we build at OpenAI. As we deploy GPT-4.1 into ChatGPT, we want to share some insights from our safety work. 🧵

author: JoHeidecke
text: We are particularly focused on studying adversarial fine-tuning and other risks unique to open models. As with all model releases, we’re conducting extensive safety testing, both internally and with trusted third-party experts, prior to public release.

author: JoHeidecke
text: Safety is a core focus of our open-weight model’s development, from pre-training to release. While open models bring unique challenges, we’re guided by our Preparedness Framework and will not release models we believe pose catastrophic risks.
